handCheckSample.fsdQuote: A collection's screen shows its title, number of series and actions menu, and a collection synced from an outside service also shows how many of the source's series are on this server and when it last synced.
handCheckSample.note: The header shows title, actions menu and series count; for externally sourced collections a sync progress (collected / total) and last-sync tooltip appear.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
handCheckSample.note: Cache size is validated with a minimum of 50.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: In reorder mode each item gets a remove button, and an Order Numbers switch adds a box to each item for typing its new position.
handCheckSample.note: In edit mode the list shows remove buttons and an Order Numbers switch that enables accessibility mode.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: Users without the Read Only role can choose which rows appear, and in what order, from the Customize page in their settings.
handCheckSample.note: The Customize settings tab is hidden from users with the Read Only role.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: Clicking the title of one of these rows opens All Series with a matching filter and sort order.
handCheckSample.note: Each row's title click builds a filter and sort (last chapter added, read progress, created, or genre) and navigates to all-series.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: A Reset to Default button restores these settings after a confirmation.
handCheckSample.note: Reset to Default asks for confirmation, then calls the reset API and reloads the form.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The list's owner sees an Edit button and, on larger screens, a Reorder button.
handCheckSample.note: Edit and Reorder (hidden below md) buttons are shown only when the list is owned by the user.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: Series appear as cards with a jump bar for skipping to a starting letter, and several series can be selected at once for a bulk action.
handCheckSample.note: Series are shown as cards in a layout with jump bar keys and bulk operations, with selection allowed.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The arrow beside the Read button offers the same action in incognito mode, which does not save progress.
handCheckSample.note: The split dropdown beside Read has one item that reads in incognito mode (glasses icon).

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The Edit button is shown only to administrators, and the Download button only to administrators and users with the Download role.
handCheckSample.note: The Edit button is wrapped in an admin check, and the download button is only rendered when canDownload() is true.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: in book and light novel libraries the Volumes tab is called Books.
handCheckSample.note: The Volumes tab title switches to Books when the book logic applies.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: It has a jump bar but no filter panel.
handCheckSample.note: The collections screen passes jump bar keys and disables filtering.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The filter panel builds rules on fields such as genre, tag, people, read progress, rating and publication status, and the rules can match all or any of them.
handCheckSample.note: The metadata builder offers an And/Or combination selector over the filter statements.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: has a Related tab listing the reading lists that contain the chapter when there are any.
handCheckSample.note: The chapter's Related tab is shown only when the chapter's readingLists list is non-empty.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The Want to Read screen lists the series the user has starred, with a count and the same filter panel and bulk selection as a library screen.
handCheckSample.note: The screen shows a series count, filter panel, and bulk operations over series cards.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: with a Read button whose menu also offers incognito reading.
handCheckSample.note: The Read/Continue button has a dropdown with incognito (glasses) read and continue items.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The Reviews tab appears on a volume only when the volume holds a single chapter.
handCheckSample.note: The volume's Reviews tab is wrapped in a check that the volume has exactly one chapter.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: All Series lists the series from every library the user can access, with the same filter panel and bulk selection as a library screen.
handCheckSample.note: All Series uses the same card layout with a filter panel and bulk operations.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: If the invite email cannot be sent, the form shows the invite link so the administrator can pass it on.
handCheckSample.note: The invite response's emailLink is stored in a signal that is shown and disables further sending.

handCheckSample.fsdQuote: The Collections screen shows every collection the user can see, with the name of the user who created it and a mark on promoted collections.
handCheckSample.note: Each collection card shows an owner component as subtitle and a promoted icon beside the title.
